agentCardUrl.description: URL of the agent card, fetched on create and on every refresh-card. Set this or agentCardJson, not both.

headers.description: Newline-separated Name:Value lines, sent with the card fetch and every call. A value of exactly %ASSETS/<asset-name>% is replaced by that Orchestrator asset's value, from the agent's folder, each time the header is sent. An Authorization line is not sent while the agent has a connection.

agentCardJson.description: The agent card as a JSON string, stored as the card instead of fetching one. The service calls the endpoint the card names. Set this or agentCardUrl, not both.

connectionId.description: Integration Service connection whose token authenticates the card fetch and every call, in place of an Authorization header. Use an OAuth connection of the Agent 2 Agent connector (uipath-google-agent2agent), the one Agent Gateway offers: the service stores any connection Integration Service finds, and one it gets no OAuth token from fails every call.

useRelay.description: Route the card fetch and every call through UiPath Relay, for an agent in a private network.
